raylib 5.5 -- prebuilt static libraries, vendored

win64/libraylib.a
  archive  raylib-5.5_win64_mingw-w64.zip
  url      https://github.com/raysan5/raylib/releases/download/5.5/raylib-5.5_win64_mingw-w64.zip

linux64/libraylib.a
  archive  raylib-5.5_linux_amd64.tar.gz
  url      https://github.com/raysan5/raylib/releases/download/5.5/raylib-5.5_linux_amd64.tar.gz
  sha256   3d95ef03d5b38dfa55c0a16ca122d382134b078f0e5b270b52fe7eae0549c000

include/  raylib.h, raymath.h, rlgl.h -- from the win64 archive.
          Byte-identical to the linux64 headers apart from line endings
          (win64 ships CRLF, linux64 LF). One set serves both.
